name: 会议记录员
description: Granola 式会议记录:会中只采麦克风,MediaRecorder 分段轮转录音,每段送 Forsion 自己的语音识别(设置 → 语音)实时转写——音频转写后即弃,不落盘、不外传;你随手记的要点与完整转写落进笔记库 markdown(工作文件夹,默认「会议记录员」)。会后由本机 Tangu(随包「会议书记官」Agent)融合要点与转写生成结构化纪要与行动项;所有会议的未完成行动项跨会议聚合追踪,勾选直接回写原笔记。
descriptionEn: Granola-style meeting notes: microphone only, recorded in rotating MediaRecorder segments, each transcribed live through Forsion's own speech recognition (Settings → Voice) — audio is discarded right after transcription, never stored or sent anywhere else; your quick notes and the full transcript land in your vault as markdown (work folder, "会议记录员" by default). Afterwards local Tangu (the bundled Meeting Scribe agent, listed under its Chinese name "会议书记官") merges notes and transcript into structured minutes plus action items; open action items from every meeting are tracked in one place, and ticking one writes straight back to its source note.

onboarding.intro: 会中录音 + 随手记要点,分段实时转写;会后 AI 把你的要点与完整转写融合成结构化纪要与行动项。配套「会议书记官」Agent 已内嵌在本捆绑包,引擎启动时自动就位,无需另装。

steps.title: 语音识别与麦克风权限
steps.description: 转写走 Forsion 自己的语音链路:在 设置 → 语音 里选好识别模型(本地离线 SenseVoice / 自带 key 的 provider / Forsion 云),本插件零 ASR 配置。首次点「开始录音」时系统会请求麦克风权限(macOS:系统设置 › 隐私与安全 › 麦克风)。

steps.title: 开一场会
steps.description: 命令面板「会议记录员:打开」进入工作台;填标题与会人点「开始录音」,或直接「会议记录员:立即开始录音」。会中左栏看实时转写(每段转写完即落盘),右栏随手记要点(Enter 落一条,自动带相对时间戳);关掉视图录音不断,状态栏可见「● 录音中」计时。

steps.title: 会后纪要与行动项
steps.description: 点「结束录音」完成剩余分段转写,再点「生成纪要」:AI 只根据你的要点与转写产出纪要 + 行动项(行格式 - [ ] 内容 @负责人 📅日期,绝不发明决议)。「行动项总览」跨会议聚合未完成项,按截止日排序、过期红标,勾选直接回写原笔记。注意:只采集麦克风、不保存音频原文件、关闭应用即结束录音。

en.intro: Record the meeting while you capture quick notes, transcribed live segment by segment; afterwards AI merges your notes with the full transcript into structured minutes and action items. The companion Meeting Scribe agent (listed under its Chinese name "会议书记官") ships inside this bundle and is seeded automatically when the engine starts — nothing else to install.

steps.title: Speech recognition and microphone access
steps.description: Transcription rides Forsion's own voice pipeline: pick a recognition model under Settings → Voice (offline SenseVoice / bring-your-own-key provider / Forsion cloud) — this plugin needs zero ASR configuration. The first time you hit Start recording the system asks for microphone permission (macOS: System Settings › Privacy & Security › Microphone).

steps.title: Run a meeting
steps.description: Open the workbench from the command palette ("Meeting Recorder: Open"), fill in title and attendees, hit Start recording — or jump straight in with "Meeting Recorder: Start recording now". During the meeting the left column shows the live transcript (each segment is saved as soon as it is transcribed) and the right column takes your notes (Enter captures one, timestamped automatically). Closing the view does not stop the recording: the status bar keeps the "● Recording" timer.

steps.title: Minutes and action items afterwards
steps.description: Stop recording to finish the remaining segments, then hit Generate minutes: the AI works only from your notes and the transcript (action lines are - [ ] task @owner 📅date, and it never invents decisions). "All action items" gathers every open item across meetings, sorted by due date with overdue ones flagged, and ticking one writes back to its source note. Note: microphone only, no audio file is kept, and quitting the app ends the recording.
